starting-off.player: Hello there. What are you doing out here?

starting-off.speaker: Alan
starting-off.text: You found me! What a day, huh, Humpy Plumpy?

starting-off.speaker: Alan
starting-off.text: Yes, yes... In fact, I've been getting rather used to life out here.

starting-off.player: I see... So, who are you, and how did you end up here?

starting-off.speaker: Alan
starting-off.text: Oh, I'm Alan. I was just visiting the area as a tourist, but I ended up straying from the pack a little.

starting-off.player: Do you need a hand getting back to civilization? I could maybe help you out if so.

starting-off.speaker: Alan
starting-off.text: Oh, no thank you. Like I say, I've actually come to quite like it here. Had I never got lost, I might never have met my best friend, Numpty Bumpty.

starting-off.speaker: Alan
starting-off.text: Still, it is nice for us to finally have a guest. In fact, you should stay for a while! I'll prepare a little feast for us all! What do you say?

steps.player: Well, I suppose I can't say no to that.

steps.speaker: Alan
steps.text: Wonderful! Would you mind staying here while I go out and gather the food? I may not have known you long, but I'm sure I can trust you to keep an eye on Wumty Scrumpty over there.

steps.player: Of course!

steps.text: A cutscene starts.

steps.speaker: Alan
steps.text: Right, time for me to get going. Don't worry, Hampty, our new friend here is going to take good care of you while I'm gone. Love you lots. Miss you already.

steps.player: Hello there, egg.

steps.text: The egg falls to the ground.

If the player has the profanity filter disabled:

steps.player: Bollocks.

options.text: I've got something else to do first.

steps.player: I've got something else to do first.

steps.speaker: Alan
steps.text: Okay, I'll wait until you return. Just don't go getting lost out there!

steps.player: Thank you for the offer, but I really must get going... Maybe another time.

steps.player: This isn't good. I'd better head into town and try to find some help.

steps.player: We need to do something!

starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.text: Nilsal. What is it you need help with?

starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.player: This might sound a little strange... but Rumpty Bumpty fell off a wall.
He's an egg. I need to get him fixed up.

starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.speaker: Farmer
starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.text: You want to put a broken egg back together again?

starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.speaker: Farmer
starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.text: I don't think I can... but I might know of somebody who could help. You should speak to the local bartender. Her resourcefulness has earned her quite the reputation. Everyone calls her King.

starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.player: King? Okay, I'll try and find her. Thanks!

starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.speaker: King
starting-off-the-great-fall-talking-to-t.text: Welcome, iknami. What can I get you?

steps.player: Are you the king?

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: The king? No, no, you won't be finding anybody like that around these parts!

steps.player: Sorry, what I meant was... are you King?

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Oh! That's me, yes. What can I do for you?

steps.player: It's about Pumpty Lumpty.

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Scrumpty Lumpy?

steps.player: Yes, yes, the egg. He fell off a wall.

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: An egg fell off a wall?

steps.player: It was a disaster! He's everywhere! I was told that if anybody could help put him together again, it would be you.

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Yes, I guess I have managed to gain a bit of a reputation when it comes to situations like this. After all, there's a reason everyone calls me King.

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Still, putting a broken egg back together again... That does sound like quite the challenge. Unfortunately, I'm afraid I need to stay here and man the bar. However...

steps.player: Yes?

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: I have a plan, but it's going to take all my horses and all my men.

steps.player: What's a horse?

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: I have no idea.

steps.player: Oh... Well, what about these men?

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: They'll be up to the task, but you'll need to rally them up.

steps.player: Okay, where can I find your men?

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Nezketi should be in the temple just south of here, Kauayotl will most likely be just outside the main entrance into town, and Acatzin is right here in the inn.

steps.player: Thanks! I'll have them gathered in no time.

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.player: I don't want to buy one! I'm here to pick up one that you're repairing.

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.speaker: Blacksmith
all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.text: Okay, yes, I can repair an axe for you. It won't be quick though as I have a lot of other work to get through first.

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.player: The axe is already here. I'm just here to pick it up.

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.speaker: Blacksmith
all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.text: Well, you can't. No repairs are getting done until the whetstone is fixed!

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.player: Well, what's wrong with the whetstone?

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.speaker: Blacksmith
all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.text: Yes, the whetstone! Are you going to get it fixed or are you just going to keep standing around like that?

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.player: Okay... I guess I can try and fix the whetstone.

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.speaker: Blacksmith
all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-the-blacks.text: Too slow! We need to speed things up! Let's come together and fix this whetstone!

options.text: I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?

steps.player: I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?

steps.speaker: Kauayotl
steps.text: That would be appreciated. I reckon a couple of planks and some nails should be all you need to get it fixed. I'm sure you can find some around here somewhere. Oh, and don't forget your hammer and saw!

options.text: We have bigger problems right now!

steps.player: We have bigger problems right now!

steps.speaker: Kauayotl
steps.text: My friend, I know your plight, but the cart must be sorted before I can do anything else. I'm sorry.

all-the-king-s-men-talking-to-kauayotl-t.speaker: Kauayotl

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: King
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Welcome back, iknami. What can I get you?

steps.player: I've gathered your men.

steps.speaker: King
steps.text: Then I've done all I can. The rest is now in their hands, and yours. Good luck, iknami.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: This isn't good, iknami. We don't think there's any way we can put this egg back together again.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: What are we going to do?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: The way I see it, we only have one option. We need to replace the egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: It's more than madness. There isn't even a word to properly describe what it is. However, I fear it is the only path available to us.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: But where would we even get a replacement egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: We're going to need to obtain a chicken egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Tetamo! That's preposterous! A chicken egg is far too small.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Not if it's from a rather large chicken.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: A dragon egg is what we need. They are the perfect size.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: A dragon egg would be suicide. No dragon would willingly give up its egg. What we need is a jaguar egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: But jaguars don't lay eggs...

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: How about we gather a few potential eggs and pick the best one?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: Kuani! What a brilliant idea.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: Okay, I just need to know where I can find these eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There are some dragons in a cave just south east of here, across the river from Tal Teklan. One of them should have an egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There's a chicken farm on the outskirts of Tal Teklan. I reckon you'll be able to find a large chicken egg there.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: And I've heard talk of some eggs in an old camp site by the mine east of Tal Teklan. Apparently the camp site is a hot spot for jaguars! They must be jaguar eggs!

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: Right then. I'll be back once I have some eggs.
Remind me, where can I find a dragon egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Kauayotl
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There are some dragons in a cave just south east of here, across the river from Tal Teklan. One of them should have a suitable egg.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: I'll head over there and try to find one.
Remind me, where can I find a large chicken egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Acatzin
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: There's a farm on the outskirts of Tal Teklan. I reckon you'll be able to find one there.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: Remind me, where can I find a jaguar egg?

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.speaker: Nezketi
talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: I've heard talk of some in an old camp site by the mine east of Tal Teklan.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.player: I'll have a look and see if I can find them.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player attempts to take a large egg from the egg pile:

steps.text: A nearby chicken doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of its eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the large chicken:

steps.text: You find a nice large egg. You take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the large chicken without enough inventory space:

steps.text: You find a nice large egg, but you don't have enough room to take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player attempts to take a jaguar egg from the egg pile:

steps.text: A nearby jaguar doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of its eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the black jaguar:

steps.text: You find an egg. You're not convinced a jaguar laid it, but you take it anyway.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the black jaguar without enough inventory space:

steps.text: You find an egg, but you don't have enough room to take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player attempts to take a dragon egg from the egg pile:

steps.text: A nearby dragon doesn't take kindly to you trying to take one of its eggs.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the Red dragon:

steps.text: You find a dragon egg. You take it.

talking-to-king-after-gathering-all-her-.text: If the player takes an egg after defeating the Red dragon without enough inventory space:

steps.text: You find a dragon egg, but you don't have enough room to take it.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.player: I managed to find a large chicken egg!

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.speaker: Acatzin
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.text: Good work! I'll get it set up so its ready to be judged.
Acatzin sets up the chicken egg.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.speaker: Acatzin
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-talking-.text: The chicken egg is ready to be judged. You should get the other eggs gathered.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.player: I managed to find a dragon egg!

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.speaker: Kauayotl
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.text: Kuani! Excellent work! I'll get it ready to go.
Kauayotl sets up the dragon egg.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.speaker: Kauayotl
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-kauayotl.text: The dragon egg is ready to be judged. You should get the other eggs gathered.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi.speaker: Nezketi
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi.text: Kuani! I'll get it set up and ready to be judged.
Nezketi sets up the jaguar egg.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi-.speaker: Nezketi
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-nezketi-.text: The jaguar egg is all set up and ready to be judged. You should work on gathering the other eggs.

after-collecting-the-three-eggs-after-pl.speaker: Kauayotl
after-collecting-the-three-eggs-after-pl.text: That's the last one. Let's get these eggs judged.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: We've prettied them up as best we can. Hopefully one of them looks like Scrumpty Lumpy.

judging-the-eggs.player: Hmm... It's not bad, but I think it's just a little bit too small to be Humpty Fumty.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: Well, what about the dragon egg?

judging-the-eggs.player: It's a good size, but the face... it seems to be melting off. I think the egg is too warm.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: The jaguar egg then? It's a perfect size and it's the right temperature.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: I still don't think it's actually a jaguar egg...

judging-the-eggs.player: Well, regardless of what it is, I do think it might be the one.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: Kuani! Good work everyone. I think we've done it!
All three eggs fall to the ground.
If the player has the profanity filter enabled:
If the player has the profanity filter disabled:

steps.speaker: King's men and the Player
steps.text: Bollocks.

judging-the-eggs.player: What are we going to do now?

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: We gave it our best, but I fear we have failed.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Acatzin
judging-the-eggs.text: There's only one thing for it. We're going to have to put Pumpty Lumpty back together again.

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs.text: But how? He was broken beyond repair!

judging-the-eggs.speaker: Nezketi
judging-the-eggs.text: We don't have any other options. We have to try.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: The player attempts to put the eggs together in one piece.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Kauayotl
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: Indeed it is. I think this means our work here is done.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.player: Thank you. I don't think I could have done it without you three.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Acatzin
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: Don't mention it. We're happy to have helped. Now, we should leave you to it.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: I'm back! How was Plumper? He didn't cause you any problems, did he?

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.player: Er... No. No problems at all.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: Wonderful! I'm so glad to hear it. Now, I've got quite the meal lined up for us. Would you mind giving me a hand bringing everything inside?

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: You know, friend, it wasn't until now that I came to realise that I'd actually been lost for a long time. I had a job back home... I had a family... and yet, something was missing.

judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.speaker: Alan
judging-the-eggs-talking-to-any-of-king-.text: But now... now I think I've finally found myself. For the first time in my life, I know who I am... who I'm meant to be. I think this can be a proper home. A home for me, and for Rumpy as well. A forever home.
Alan falls to the ground, dying at the bottom of the stairs.
If the player has the profanity filter enabled:
If the player has the profanity filter disabled:

steps.player: Bollocks.

post-quest-dialogue-nezketi.player: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Mumpty Rumpty.

post-quest-dialogue-nezketi.speaker: Nezketi
post-quest-dialogue-nezketi.text: Don't mention it, iknami. Always happy to be of service.

post-quest-dialogue-acatzin.player: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Rumpty Bumpty.

post-quest-dialogue-king.speaker: King
post-quest-dialogue-king.text: Welcome back, iknami. I hear you managed to solve your egg problem.

post-quest-dialogue-king.player: I did. Your men were a big help.

post-quest-dialogue-king.speaker: King
post-quest-dialogue-king.text: Glad to hear it. Now, what can I get you?

post-quest-dialogue-kauayotl.player: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Mumpty Rumpty.

post-quest-dialogue-kauayotl.speaker: Kauayotl
post-quest-dialogue-kauayotl.text: It was my pleasure, iknami. We of course wouldn't have been able to do it without you either.
